title: Puharich as the earlier stage of the research Jordan went through

tellings.quote: >> uh he likely championed the earlier iteration of research that I later experienced

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he went through secret psychic research as a child in upstate New York around 2008 to 2010, tells Michels that a man named Puharich "likely championed the earlier iteration" of that same research, decades before. Jose places Puharich's work from about 1970 onward and offers the link as his own reading, not as something he saw. If he is right, the programme he describes has roots stretching back some forty years.
